about: Which marketplaces fit which product types, and each marketplace's listing profile. Agent proposal, built 2026-11-14 from the notes in this folder. Evidence marks are in the notes; a profile's unconfirmed list names what was not read at the source.

verdicts.best: a top place for it; post by default
verdicts.ok: will sell but not a strength; post only when the person asks for more reach
verdicts.avoid: allowed but a poor fit; do not post, say why, let the person override
verdicts.blocked: not allowed or no category; never post

touchup_levels.0: true color: white balance and exposure only, no model
touchup_levels.2: pressed: off everywhere until Ben decides

types.luxury_handbags: Luxury handbags and small leather goods

ebay.name: eBay
ebay.sells: shipped, plus local pickup through checkout

title.template: Brand Line/Model Type ModelNo Size Color Attribute

description.style: spec sheet: what it is, condition and every flaw, measurements, what is included

tags.instead: category, item specifics, condition, catalog match

price.offers: Best Offer on; auto-accept at target; auto-decline under 80% of list

ebay.fee: 13.6% of the total sale plus $0.40 in most categories; 8% for sneakers at $150 and up
ebay.free_lever: offers to watchers; 30-day returns and 1-day handling rank
ebay.paid_lever: Promoted Listings general, off by default
ebay.refresh: revise the price 5 to 10% every 21 days; no end-and-relist before 60 days

facebook.name: Facebook Marketplace
facebook.sells: local pickup; shipping off by default

description.style: six short lines: what, condition, dimensions, flaws, what is included, pickup area

price.list_at: target x 1.10 at $50 and up; next $5 up from $20 to $50; target under $20
price.offers: chat only; nothing binds until the handoff

facebook.fee: local sale: none; shipped with checkout: 10%, $0.80 minimum
facebook.free_lever: renew at day 7; reply within minutes
facebook.paid_lever: boost, off; never Cost per Sale
facebook.refresh: day 7 renew; day 14 cut 10% and renew; day 21 cut again; day 30 with no saves, delete and relist
unconfirmed: whether a generative touch-up gets an AI info label

depop.name: Depop

title.template: first line of the description: Brand Item Detail Size

description.style: five short lines in a casual voice, flaws always stated, measurements

tags.default: 0 to 5 true hashtags at the end, at most one brand

price.offers: auto-send an offer to likers 10% under list; auto-negotiate at the user's floor

depop.fee: 0% selling fee; 3.3% plus $0.45 processing on item, shipping and tax
depop.free_lever: offers to likers through the partner API; complete every structured field
depop.paid_lever: Boost at 12%, never without a tap
depop.refresh: edit in place; after 21 days propose a 10% cut; relist only a listing with no likes

poshmark.name: Poshmark

title.template: Brand Style Item Detail Color Size

description.style: five-line template, measurements always, flaws always

price.list_at: target / 0.85, whole dollars, never under $15 for a single item
price.offers: Smart Sell with the floor as minimum, or one Offer to Likers at 10% off

poshmark.free_lever: Offer to Likers with a shipping discount; ship within 2 days
poshmark.refresh: day 14 rewrite the title; day 21 new cover or 10% drop; day 45 with zero likes, delete and relist
unconfirmed: category list behind each blocked verdict

mercari.name: Mercari

title.template: Brand Item Model/Character/Style Size Color New/NWT

description.style: 3 to 6 lines, flaws named with the photo number, then 3 hashtags

price.offers: Smart Offers minimum at target; Offer to Likers at 10% off

mercari.fee: 10% of item price plus buyer-paid shipping
mercari.free_lever: price cuts are the boost: Offer to Likers 10%, Time-limited Sale 10%, Promote 5%
mercari.refresh: one real edit every 7 days; no routine delete and relist

offerup.name: OfferUp

description.style: plain facts, dimensions, flaws, pickup area

offerup.fee: none; free listing caps per category per month
offerup.free_lever: reply fast; stay inside the free listing caps
unconfirmed: title and description limits (50 and 1,000 are safe caps, not published limits)
whether a generative touch-up counts as a photo of the actual item

grailed.name: Grailed

description.style: 20 to 60 words, measurements, every flaw, 3 to 6 hashtags

price.list_at: target / 0.85; keep the floor at $119 if the sale would land between $120 and $123
price.offers: offers bind on acceptance; decline under 70% of asking

grailed.fee: 6% under $120 ($1.99 minimum), 9% from $120, plus 3.49% and $0.49 processing
grailed.free_lever: a 10% price drop tops the feed and notifies everyone who favorited; free bump every 7 days for 30 days
grailed.refresh: bump every 7 days; from day 30 a bump needs a 10% drop; never relist a listing with favorites
unconfirmed: category tree behind each blocked verdict
terms ban third-party tools without written consent, so posting needs a hand-off or consent
